# IDEAL MOCKUPS PRIVATE LIMITED

IDEAL MOCKUPS PRIVATE LIMITED is a Design Services company. IdealMockups is a professional mockup making company that offers design and fabrication services for full and reduced scaled models of new product concepts, parts components, and new products. IDEAL MOCKUPS PRIVATE LIMITED employs 5 people, founded in 2012. Headquartered in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across India and United States.

## About

IDEAL MOCKUPS PRIVATE LIMITED is India's first registered high-fidelity mockup making company which uses CNC machines for fabrication of mockups. The company provides design and fabrication services for full and small scale models of new product concepts, part components and new products.
